# awscc_mgn_wave (Resource)

Resource schema for AWS::MGN::Wave. A Wave is a logical grouping used in Application Migration Service to organize and manage the migration of applications.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the wave.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description of the wave.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Tags to assign to the wave. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the wave.
- `creation_date_time` (String) The timestamp when the wave was created.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `is_archived` (Boolean) Whether the wave is archived.
- `last_modified_date_time` (String) The timestamp when the wave was last modified.
- `wave_aggregated_status` (Attributes) The aggregated migration status of the wave. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--wave_aggregated_status))
- `wave_id` (String) The unique identifier of the wave.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.


<a id="nestedatt--wave_aggregated_status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `wave_aggregated_status`

Read-Only:

- `health_status` (String) The health status of the wave.
- `progress_status` (String) The progress status of the wave.
- `total_applications` (Number) The total number of applications in the wave.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_mgn_wave.example
  identity = {
    arn = "arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the wave

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_mgn_wave.example
  id = "arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_mgn_wave.example "arn"
```
